description: Remaining three templates in the MQ-TEMPLATES region: memory (flip pairs), sequence (order tiles), sort (bins). Depends on FEAT-003 framework; the three templates are independent of each other.
steps: Add adaptTemplateGame(def) for memory (pairs, 3 pair minimum, sides with optional compact visual), sequence (rounds, 2 round minimum, steps stored in correct order, client shuffle guaranteed different), sort (bins 2-3, items min 6, bin index in range); rebuild fresh objects; drop items with malformed visual.

Implement memory module: 2n shuffled cards as toggle buttons with aria-pressed and labels, two-flip state machine with lock, 1200 ms mismatch back-flip via tplLater, moves counter, stars rule, roving arrow keys, 3 columns at phone width.
Implement sequence module: tray and numbered slots, tap to place or return, Check locks correct slots and returns wrong ones, per-round attempts stars, averaged result.
Implement sort module: item queue, 2-3 bin buttons (keys 1-3 and arrows), wrong item re-queued with rule shown, role=progressbar, mistakes stars, no lose state.
Add themes in the Phase 3 CSS block and COPY lines; extend templates.test.js and client.test.js for each template (win, stars, hint, replay, keyboard, teardown, minimum-items null).
Commit: feat(client): Memory Match; feat(client): Order It and Sort It.
acceptance_criteria: Each template completes to a results screen with Play again, My games, Back to home
Each interactive tile is a real button with an aria-label
Game below the item minimum shows the cantPlay copy
